title: 第19章 斩火煞听回声第20章 燃血破幻陆玄举剑
content_zh:
陆玄一跃而下，大约坠落了十丈左右的距离，而后触地。
十丈高度对于胎息修士尚有些许风险，但对炼炁士而言，就不过寻常了。
云炁附着脚底，陆玄稳稳落地。
“轰！”
但他尚未来得及细看洞中场景，一团赤色的火球就猛然砸向他的脑袋。
“噌！”
陆玄虽然未曾开窍，不曾拥有灵识，但五感敏锐，反应极快，抽剑一劈，那火球犹如实体，竟然被一分为二，擦着陆玄脑袋的两边呼啸而过，撞击在背后的岩石上，发出爆炸的轰鸣。
赤乌剑乃是灵兵，可斩末等法。
“桀！”
可紧随在火球之后的，是一具滚烫的赤影。
这赤影约丈许高，极为高大，似一具火焰巨人，但周身却附着了一层灰色的岩石，让原本虚幻的灵体有了实质。
灵体有了实质，就可干预现实，袭击修士。
此刻这赤影发出一声怪叫，飞扑而来，五爪如刀，力大无比，爪上还有滚烫高温，让空中的光影都微微扭曲。
可陆玄反应更快，他脚下附着云炁，刹那之间飞旋后退，瞬息拉开数丈，让那赤影扑了个空。
不仅如此，陆玄于空中顿住，而后云炁喷涌，瞬息加速，趁那赤影扑空力尽之际，拉近距离。
与此同时，右臂举剑，猛然一斩。
“呲！”
赤乌剑在空中划过一道细碎的虹光，一具灰白色的头颅被斩开。
“噗！”
头颅被斩开，那赤影顿时像泄了气的皮球一样，猛然瘪了下去，最后化为一缕赤色的火气消散在天地间。

原地只剩下一枚拇指大小，散发着淡淡火光的“碎石”。
“这就是火煞之核？”
陆玄暗忖。
他于千经阁中，已经得知了火煞的来历。
所谓火煞，就是这洞中的火灵之炁和地脉的污浊之炁混杂，犹如“雨滴”落下，附着在了“核”上，从而有了形体，喜袭活物。
“核”不同，火灵的形态亦是不同。
但这“核”，并不玄妙，就是洞中常见的石、草、土、虫等物。
只要能承载一缕灵炁，都可被称为核。
刚刚袭击他的这具火煞，身负石甲，就是火炁和浊炁混杂，落在一“碎石”上，借助石之力，有了石之形体。
“也能值上些碎灵石。”
陆玄袖袍一挥，将此核收入储物袋中。
content_en:
Lu Xuan jumped down and fell about ten feet before touching the ground.
The height of ten feet is still a bit risky for the fetal breath monks, but for the alchemy monks, it is just ordinary.
Yun Qi clung to the soles of his feet, and Lu Xuan landed steadily.
"Boom!"
But before he could take a closer look at the scene in the cave, a red fireball suddenly hit his head.
"Oops!"
Although Lu Xuan had never been enlightened and had no spiritual knowledge, his five senses were sharp and his reactions were extremely fast. With a slash of his sword, the fireball was split into two parts like a solid object. It whizzed past the two sides of Lu Xuan's head and hit the rock behind him, making an explosive roar.
The Red Crow Sword is a spiritual weapon that can be used to cut off enemies.
"Jie!"
But right behind the fireball was a scalding red shadow.
This red shadow was about ten feet tall, extremely tall, like a flaming giant, but it was covered with a layer of gray rock, giving substance to the originally illusory spirit body.
Once the spirit has substance, it can interfere with reality and attack monks.
At this moment, the red shadow let out a strange cry and flew toward it. Its five claws were like knives and extremely powerful. The claws were still hot and the light and shadow in the air were slightly distorted.
But Lu Xuan reacted faster. Yun Qi was attached to his feet, and he flew back in an instant, pulling away several feet in an instant, allowing the red shadow to fly away.
Not only that, Lu Xuan paused in the air, and then the cloud energy spurted out, accelerating instantly, and took advantage of the red shadow to close the distance when it was exhausted.
At the same time, he raised his sword with his right arm and slashed suddenly.
"Bah!"
The red black sword drew a thin rainbow light in the air, and a gray-white head was chopped open.
"Poof!"
After the head was cut open, the red shadow suddenly deflated like a deflated rubber ball, and finally turned into a wisp of red fire and dissipated between the sky and the earth.
Only a piece of "gravel" the size of a thumb was left in place, exuding a faint glow of fire.
"Is this the core of the fire evil?"
Lu Xuan thought to himself.
He had already learned the origin of the Fire Demon in Qianjing Pavilion.
The so-called fire evil means that the energy of the fire spirit in the cave is mixed with the filthy energy of the earth veins. It falls like "raindrops" and adheres to the "core", thus taking shape and attacking living creatures.
The "core" is different, and the shape of the fire spirit is also different.
But this "core" is not mysterious. It is the common stones, grass, soil, insects and other objects in the cave.
As long as it can carry a ray of spiritual energy, it can be called a core.
The fire demon that just attacked him was wearing stone armor. It was a mixture of fire energy and turbid energy. It fell on a "gravel" and took the form of a stone with the help of the power of the stone.
"It's also worth some broken spirit stones."
Lu Xuan waved his sleeves and put the core into his storage bag.
